text:
Estimated items served:
- Spaghetti with meat sauce and cheese, about 350 g: roughly 550 kcal.
- Roast chicken drumstick and a few slices of breast: roughly 300 kcal.
- Fruit bowl (watermelon, apple, melon): roughly 80 kcal.
- Greek salad with feta and olives, dressing in the bottle: roughly 150 kcal for the salad, plus about 120 kcal for the dressing if all of it is used.
- Juice, about 250 ml: roughly 110 kcal.

Served total: 550 + 300 + 80 + 150 + 120 + 110 = 1310 kcal. I rounded this to 1300.

The photo shows the meal before eating, so leftovers are a guess. I assumed about 15% is left, or roughly 200 kcal. That gives about 1100 kcal eaten.

Macronutrients for the amount eaten:
- Protein: spaghetti about 25 g, chicken about 40 g, salad about 8 g, fruit about 1 g, so roughly 74 g. I rounded this to 70 g.
- Carbohydrate: spaghetti about 80 g, fruit about 18 g, salad about 10 g, juice about 26 g, so roughly 134 g. I rounded this to 135 g.
- Fat: spaghetti about 20 g, chicken about 18 g, salad and dressing about 25 g, so roughly 63 g. I rounded this to 55 g to account for the leftovers.
